sections.title: Who this page is for
sections.intro: Buyers who already use TicNote hardware, or who want more transcription minutes and Shadow AI capacity without buying another device, and need a clear comparison before asking CNPS.AI for Cloud Pro or Business.
items: Teams comparing Free / Standard entitlements with paid Pro or Business upgrades
Procurement leads who need userguide list prices labelled as informational, not as a live cart quote
Hardware buyers who already see device-bound annual rates in the TicNote app after activation

sections.title: Checkout status on CNPS.AI
sections.intro: Online checkout for standalone Cloud Pro and Cloud Business on shop.cnps.ai is coming soon. Until then, this page is explanatory only: there is no shop checkout button for cloud plans, and list prices must not be treated as a live cart quote.
items: Inquire via the contact form or mailto:sales@cnps.ai for Cloud Pro and Business
Read the official plan definitions on the TicNote userguide
For hardware + 1-Year Pro SKUs already sold on shop.cnps.ai, use the Pro plan page and the TicNote / Lite product pages

sections.title: Device-bound annual rates (hardware owners)
sections.intro: After you activate eligible TicNote hardware, the TicNote app may show a discounted annual rate for Pro ($79/yr) and Business ($239/yr) versus the standalone annual list prices above. Those device-bound rates are not separate shop variants on CNPS.AI. See the existing hardware product pages and the hardware-bundle Pro plan page.
